Institutional Overview

About the African Labour Research and Education Institute

ALREI is the research and education institute of ITUC-Africa. It strengthens the African trade union movement through labour research, workers' education, evidence-based advocacy, and collaboration.

Contact ALREI

Our History and Missions

The African Labour Research and Education Institute (ALREI) is a semi-autonomous institute of the African Regional Organisation of the International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC-Africa). It was established to meet the research and education needs of African trade unions and to strengthen their capacity to represent workers and influence policy.

A feasibility study conducted in 2014 highlighted gaps across the continent. Many trade unions needed stronger mechanisms to conduct research and use evidence. ITUC-Africa therefore established ALREI to make structured training and knowledge accessible to trade unionists across countries, sectors, and languages.

Vision

To be an African center of excellence on the world of work and workers' rights.

Mission

Equip trade unions with practical knowledge and tools for effective action.

Governance & Location

ALREI operates under the strategic supervision of an Advisory Board and the ITUC-Africa General Council. The Advisory Board reviews policies, plans, budgets, and compliance with ethical rules.
